device.description: Isolated second-order delta-sigma modulator (+-280 mV input) with 10 MHz internal clock, CLKOUT and DOUT bit-stream outputs
device.note: amc1203.pdf (SBAS427E) p.3-4 pin configurations and functions (SOP-8 DUB / PSA, SOIC-16 DW), p.5 recommended operating conditions (AVDD, DVDD 4.5-5.5 V, +-280 mV linear range), p.10 switching characteristics (internal clock 8-12 MHz, DOUT -2..2 ns after the CLKOUT falling edge; setup/hold to the CLKOUT rising edge) and Figure 5-1, p.17 digital output (0 V = 50 % ones; 16-bit resolution with a sinc3 OSR 256 filter)

pages: p.3-4 (pinouts), p.5 (ROC), p.9 (logic levels), p.10 (switching characteristics, Figure 5-1), p.17 (digital output, Figure 6-3), p.17-18 (functional modes)
notModeled: INTERNAL CLOCK: the device generates its own 10 MHz (8-12 MHz) modulator clock and drives it on CLKOUT; DOUT changes after each CLKOUT falling edge. The schema's clocked bus needs an input clock, so the model names CLKOUT (an output that nothing drives) as the bus clock: as written DOUT only advances if CLKOUT is driven externally. The engine needs an internal-oscillator form (period 100 ns, driven on CLKOUT) to run this part

analog modulator, galvanic isolation, AVDD (high side) and the input range: DOUT is the 0 V bit stream (50 % ones, read pattern "10"); clipping beyond +-320 mV and the missing-AVDD constant-stream state (p.18) are not modeled
tOut = tD max 2 ns (DOUT after the CLKOUT falling edge); CLKOUT period / duty-cycle limits
variants: AMC1203 and AMC1203B (lower offset / gain error) share the datasheet and pinouts; the skeleton parts are all AMC1203B (DW) or AMC1203 (DUB, PSA)
